root.description: Absolute deterministic run storage root. At least the user or project layer must configure it; a run layer may not change it.

worker_profiles.description: Worker launch profiles, patched per layer by name. A profile inherits only from the same name in an earlier layer: a name no earlier layer defines must declare `role` in the layer that first defines it, or the layer is rejected with invalid_config. This cross-layer rule is enforced in code, not expressible here.

jev.description: TypeSafe Jev (System One) settings. There is no on/off flag: Jev is how this plugin reads, and without a credential the tool errors clearly while the hooks pass the untouched result through. Every value below only tunes where reading is narrowed; none of them can drop a result.

model.description: Model name sent with every request. Default jev-latest.

read_threshold_lines.description: A read of a file with at least this many lines is narrowed to the ranked ranges. Default 200.

read_view_lines.description: Line budget of a narrowed read view; ranges are added in probability order until it is spent. Default 120.

output_min_lines.description: Tool output of at least this many lines is filtered to the ranked blocks, with what was withheld reported. Default 80.

task_result_chars.description: Character cap applied to a subagent result before it enters the parent context; the rest stays in the artifact. Default 1200.

hint_min_p.description: Probability below which a judgment is reported as weak. It only chooses the one-line next action a judgment prints; it never removes a row. Default 0.6.

moments.description: Moments defined here rather than in code. A moment names when its state exists, what the state is read from, and the fixed questions asked about it.

name.description: Moment name, used as the calibration `stage` of every row it logs.

when.description: The event that carries the state: a tool result, a tool call, or a server response, optionally narrowed by path.

tool_result.description: Tool name whose result triggers the moment.

tool_call.description: Tool name whose call triggers the moment, before it runs.

server.description: Server action whose response triggers the moment, for example herdr_assignment.preflight.

path.description: Optional path or glob the trigger is restricted to.

state.description: Where the judged state is read from.

file.description: One file whose text becomes the state.

paths.description: Several paths whose chunks become the state items, in path order.

questions.description: Fixed questions by id, in the request format: each is a noul, choice, or score question whose instructions name its target by a backticked state path.

directive.description: ORCH-facing execution guidance delivered inline with the orchestrator's first prompt, as the first advisory section. Advisory only; never changes authority, scope, or completion conditions.

guidance.description: Legacy ORCH-facing profile-selection criteria for this worker profile; rendered only when intent is absent. Advisory only. Required nowhere; when a layer first defines a profile name it must still declare role (code-enforced).

intent.description: ORCH-facing profile-selection criteria for this worker profile. Advisory only; never resolves a role, model, authority, or assignment contract.

directive.description: Worker-facing execution guidance delivered inline with the assignment prompt of a lane selected with this profile, and never to another profile. Advisory only; never changes the assignment contract, and never supplies a duty missing from the packaged worker skill.

intent.description: Optional advisory prose describing what this skill does wherever the skill is named.

trigger.description: Optional advisory prose describing when this skill applies; rendered only to the ORCH.
Optional advisory prose naming when this legacy route applies.

profiles.description: Optional worker-profile scope. An undefined profile name is valid but never matches; orchestrator delivery points receive only unscoped rules.

rules.description: Advisory routes in agent/moment or legacy boundary/surface form. Routes never gate settlement, lifecycle, or authority.

skills.description: Optional per-skill authored intent and trigger metadata; no installed-presence claim.
